08f6287119beb7b0ae18e63435cb9a31f6173284.definition: A push applied to a decision, usually through time or emotion, that makes the choice harder to refuse.
08f6287119beb7b0ae18e63435cb9a31f6173284.gloss: A push applied to a decision, usually through time or emotion, that makes the choice harder to refuse.

08f6287119beb7b0ae18e63435cb9a31f6173284.gloss: 時間や感情によって、拒むのが難しくなるほど決定を押しつける負荷。

08f6287119beb7b0ae18e63435cb9a31f6173284.gloss: Pressão aplicada a uma decisão para torná-la mais difícil de recusar.
